title: Automated live-stack integration test in Fargate with an IAM role
description: Replace the deleted live_aws_thin_turn.sh laptop+pasted-JWT approach with a real automated check that runs inside AWS (Fargate task or Lambda) using an IAM role, so it exercises the live named ThinTurn stack end-to-end with no human copying a token. Central design question: user routes require a Cognito id_token (human OAuth) which an IAM role cannot mint; the plan must resolve how the container authenticates to initiate a user turn (worker-seeded message, a new machine/service principal, Cognito ROPC test user, or worker+health only). Respect: named stacks only, never cdk deploy --all, Computers desiredCount stays 0, Gherkin-first for any new behavior, pytest only for pure helpers.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Dispatching Composer 2.5 planner (plan-only) to resolve the auth design: how does an IAM-role container initiate a user turn when user routes require a Cognito id_token a role cannot mint? Planner reads http/app.py + control_plane.py + worker auth + infra/lib/*.ts and recommends one option. No code yet.
